mapper.sql: d.enabled = TRUE AND a.deleted_at IS NULL AND a.suspended_at IS NULL AND s.account_id = d.account_id AND s.expires_at > #{now} AND s.last_used_at > #{idleBefore}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM daily_report_push_device WHERE expo_token = #{token} AND device_id != #{deviceId}
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_report_push_device SET enabled = FALSE WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM daily_report_push_device d JOIN account_session s ON s.id = d.session_id JOIN account a ON a.id = d.account_id WHERE d.device_id = #{deviceId} AND d.account_id = #{accountId} AND )
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM daily_report_push_device d JOIN account_session s ON s.id = d.session_id JOIN account a ON a.id = d.account_id WHERE d.account_id = #{accountId} AND )

SELECT d.device_id, d.expo_token FROM daily_report_push_device d JOIN account_session s ON s.id = d.session_id JOIN account a ON a.id = d.account_id WHERE d.account_id = #{accountId} AND ORDER BY d.device_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_report_push_delivery (report_id, device_id, session_id, expo_token, created_at) SELECT r.id, d.device_id, d.session_id, d.expo_token, #{now} FROM daily_report r JOIN daily_report_push_device d ON d.account_id = r.account_id JOIN account_session s ON s.id = d.session_id JOIN account a ON a.id = d.account_id JOIN company c ON c.account_id = d.account_id WHERE r.status = 'READY' AND r.report_date = #{date} AND ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE report_id = daily_report_push_delivery.report_id
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.report_id, p.device_id, p.expo_token, p.ticket_id, r.report_date FROM daily_report_push_delivery p JOIN daily_report r ON r.id = p.report_id WHERE p.status = 'PENDING' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM daily_report_push_device d JOIN account_session s ON s.id = d.session_id JOIN account a ON a.id = d.account_id WHERE d.device_id = p.device_id AND ) ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 20
mapper.sql: p.session_id = d.session_id AND p.expo_token = d.expo_token AND r.account_id = d.account_id AND r.status = 'READY' AND r.report_date = DATE(#{now}) AND
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_report_push_delivery p JOIN daily_report_push_device d ON d.device_id = p.device_id JOIN account_session s ON s.id = d.session_id JOIN account a ON a.id = d.account_id JOIN daily_report r ON r.id = p.report_id JOIN company c ON c.account_id = d.account_id SET p.status = 'SENDING', p.started_at = #{now} WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.status = 'PENDING' AND
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM daily_report_push_delivery p JOIN daily_report_push_device d ON d.device_id = p.device_id JOIN account_session s ON s.id = d.session_id JOIN account a ON a.id = d.account_id JOIN daily_report r ON r.id = p.report_id JOIN company c ON c.account_id = d.account_id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND )
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_report_push_delivery SET status = #{status}, ticket_id = #{ticket}, error_code = #{error}, receipt_due_at = #{receiptDue} WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('SENDING', 'ACCEPTED')
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.report_id, p.device_id, p.expo_token, p.ticket_id, r.report_date FROM daily_report_push_delivery p JOIN daily_report r ON r.id = p.report_id WHERE p.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND p.receipt_due_at <= #{now} ORDER BY p.id LIMIT 20
mapper.update: UPDATE daily_report_push_device SET enabled = FALSE WHERE device_id = #{deviceId} AND expo_token = #{token}

UPDATE daily_report_push_delivery SET status = CASE WHEN status = 'PENDING' THEN 'SKIPPED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END, error_code = 'Expired' WHERE (status = 'PENDING' AND created_at < DATE(#{now})) OR (status = 'SENDING' AND started_at < TIMESTAMPADD(MINUTE, -20, #{now})) OR (status = 'ACCEPTED' AND started_at < TIMESTAMPADD(HOUR, -23, #{now}))
